GetAccountRateLimitsParams.description: Usage-read capabilities of the requesting client, never inferred from its experiment arm.

excludeResetCreditDetails.description: Skip the separate reset-credit detail lookup for background usage polls. The usage response still includes the available count; omitted/false preserves detailed reads.

newThread.description: Read a fresh root conversation's quota instead of the global login. Cannot be combined with `threadId`.

supportsLunaReserve.description: The client supports automatic Luna Reserve fallback. For eligible ChatGPT CLI users, allow the backend to record experiment exposure after ordinary usage is blocked.

threadId.description: Use the conversation's saved account rather than the current login.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory used to resolve the new conversation's configuration.

modelProvider.description: Provider override, as in `thread/start`; omission uses the server default.
